_comment: Functional graphemes for German. Only polygraphs that reliably map to ONE WikiPron phoneme are included. WikiPron encodes German diphthongs as two segments (e.g. 'Dreier' → ['d','r','a','ɪ̯','ɐ']), so ai/au/ei/eu/äu are deliberately excluded — including them would make the greedy v1 waste the digraph on half the diphthong. 'ie' maps to a single long vowel /iː/ and IS kept.
